responsibility: This header provides the public entry point for the SIMD-clone subsystem, declaring the routine that expands SIMD clones for a cgraph node. It serves as the minimal bridge between the OpenMP SIMD cloning IPA implementation and other middle-end code that needs to trigger or reference clone creation.
same_name_distinction: Provides only the minimal public declaration for triggering SIMD clone expansion, namely expand_simd_clones for a cgraph node. Unlike gcc/omp-simd-clone.cc, it does not contain the IPA analysis, clone construction, or pass implementation.
